(shrī)༄༅/ /dpal mgon legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor chog skong ba rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /swa sti/bla ma dang dpal phyag

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// dpal mgon legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor chog skong ba rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti/ bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ gnas khang bla bre dang yol ba la sogs pas brgyan/ chos skyong gi bris sku yod na bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa la ras la sogs pas bkab pa'i steng du 'bru sna tshogs gcal du dgram/ de'i steng du yi dam dang mgon po'i gtor ma zur gsum che ba/ de'i g.yon du cung zad chung ba/ de dag gi mdun du de bas chung ba/ de'i g.yon du cung chung ba rnams gnam lcags kyi phur bu lta bu mtheb kyus bskor ba la rgyan ci mdzes byas pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang ma tshang ba med par bshams la/ lha'i rnal 'byor gang yang rung ba'am/ mchog tu shis pa phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ yi dam gang byed kyi gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs nas yi dam la phul/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dmar nag khyams khor yug sgo dang bcas shing mi mgo'i mda' yab kyi kha nas rgyu ma don snying gi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/

shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rdo rje'i brag rdzong shin tu mtho ba'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ bstan pa la sdang zhing 'gro ba yongs la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ma hā kā la sku mdog char sprin ltar nag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ber nag po dgu brtsegs te gsol ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags rnam par 'gyur ba/ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum bgrad pas khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sked chings la rin po che du mas spras shing 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ sbrul nag po lto ser gyi chun po dang*/ sag ti'i l+h+wam gsol bas stag chen rngams pa la chibs shing rol du seng ge dkar po rgyan ldan 'dur zhing khrid pa/ phyag g.yas pas tsan+dan gyi bing chen rin po ches spras pas klad la 'phyar bas lha'i dmag gi dpung tshogs rnams g.yo zhing 'gyed pa/ g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa gar dgus bsgyings nas bzhugs pa'i steng na lcags kyi bya khra 'phur lding bshug pa'i sgra 'byin pa/ ce spyang 'dur zhing khrag rjes gcod pa/ 'jigs pa'i spyang ki dang khyi nag rngams zhing rgyug pa shul nas 'brang ba/ sprul pa'i dmag dpung phyogs bcur g.yo zhing dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du rlung nag 'tshubs ma dang khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho rba rlabs g.yo ba'i steng du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas khram shing dang g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/

mchan khung na nad kyi rkyal pa thogs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ sbrul gyi ga sha can/ spyi bor rma bya'i mdongs kyis mdzes pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la seng ge dang*/ g.yon pa la dug sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs shing re lde khra bo dang*/ stag gi pags pas smad g.yogs pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis brgyan pas dre'u dmar po la chibs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras shing rkang sil gyi sgra dang bcas pa snang srid kyi ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o// de'i mdun du sku'i mon pa nag po g.yas pas tri shū la'i rtse mo la mi ro dmar po'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas dar nag gi ru mtshon 'phyar bas dmag sna 'dren zhing dgra bo'i sde 'jigs par byed pa/ g.yas su thugs kyi mon pa sngo nag g.yas kyi spu gris gtubs shing*/ g.yon pas tsit+ta phyung ste gtso bo la stob pas dam nyams pa'i snying rtsa 'byin par byed pa/ g.yon du gsung gi mon pa dmar nag g.yas kyi zhags pas dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi mgul nas bcings te 'khrid pa/ g.yon pas ma he'i rwa dung 'bud pas dmag gi tshogs bsdus te dgra bgegs kyi dpung 'joms par byed pa/ rgyab

kha skong*/ tu nor bdag dzam bha la nag po g.yas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon ne'u brla steng du 'dzin pa/ dar dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing rna ba ma phug pa rigs ngan gyi cha lugs can/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyis nor bdag ser po gan rkyal du mnan pa/ de rnams kyi rgyab na bdud kyi mon pa gri thogs bdun rngam zhing bdud dmag 'bum khri'i dpung gis bskor bas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa/ mon mo kha skong*/ nag mo bdun la 'khor bud med stong khams khengs pa/ bh+yoḥdang dzaḥyi sgra sgrogs shing khrag thun gyi zor 'phen zhing dgra la dal yams gtong ba/ de'i lcags mkhar gyi phyi'i khyams la dgra bgegs gsod gcod la brtson pas bcol ba'i las byed pa ni bdud mgon nag po spyi ring mi sdug pa spu gri dang zhags pa thogs pa rta nag la zhon te snga sha dang*/ phyi sha la bdud kyi khram shing dang mi ro bkal te rgyug pa/ srog bdag 'od lha dkar po bzhon pa la zhon cing rgyal zhu dang dar dkar gyi la'u gyon nas 'khor lo dang shak+ti thogs pa dgra bgegs la brgyabs pas tshar gcod pa/ lcags gzhu nag po ral pa can so tham byed pa tri shū la dang thod khrag thogs pas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa/ btsan kha skong*/ mgon shu po srog len mdog dmar nag dar dmar gyi thod bcings pa ber dmar bse khrab gyon pa/ mdung dmar khrag gi ba dan can dang*/ btsan gyi zhags pa dmar po thogs pa/ rta dmar la zhon pa/ klu mgon nag po dug sbrul gyi gdengs ka can mjug thogs dang bcas pa sbrul zhags dang bcas pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ma he sngo nag la zhon te dgra bgegs gzir ba/ gying mgon rdo rje legs pa spyang ku zhon nas za 'og gi ber dang thod bcings pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje bya khra/ g.yon pas ra'i snying 'dzin pas las byed pa/ ma mgon rdo rje sder chen nag po rlung nag dang me dpung gi dbus na ber gyon cing ral pa gcig tu 'phyang ba/

khram shing dang nad kyi rkyal pa thogs pa/ spyang ku dang khyi nag za za 'dra ba dang 'cha' 'cha' 'dra bas bskor ba/ g.yan mgon rā hu la mgo dgu bya rog gi mgo dang bcas pa/ dud ka mig gis khengs pa/ sbrul mjug 'khyil pa/ mda' gzhu 'dzin pas dam nyams kyi yul du skyin thang chu 'khyags 'bebs pa/ gzhan yang las mkhan sprul pa g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ gshegs kyi sna 'dren byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin brgyad/ slad kyi rjes 'brang gshin rje brgyad dang bcas pa 'jig rten gyi khams khengs pas shin tu 'jigs pa hūm̐ phaṭa phaiṃ kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can dang ma la ya'i gnas mchog nas dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gsur chen gyi spos sogs dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas rnams// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ zhes dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ ye shes lha yi mtshon pa la'ang 'jug bkra shis pa'i tshig ste sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ oṃ shrī dpal nag po chen po ma hā kā la tri yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes rkyang pa'am bzlas pa yin/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bsad par gyis/ traka rak+ṣa srin po/ ha la dug gam srog 'phrog dzaḥdagra bo mā ra bsad par gyis/ ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes btags pa yum dang sgrol ba'i/ du na ru tra ru thum bha ti dzaḥ

drag po/ shū la rā rgyal po/ dza tri sha ma dzaḥ yaṃ dzaḥ badz+ra rdo rje/ tri sna sā legs pa/ dhu kha thum tri sa mā dam tshig dgongs sam bab lta bu/ dzaḥdzaḥ dgra bo mā ra sod cig ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mā ra ya rnams btags pas gtor ma 'bul dus kyi sngags dkyus ma 'di yin/ mchan/ zhes pa'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gtor ma 'di zungs zungs bzhes shig bzhes shig gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa pū gtor ma 'di zungs gsol zhig dza hoḥ rak+ta pi khrag gsol zhig pa hoḥ sa ma dam tshig la/ ye/ swā hā/ gzhi tshugs sam gnas lta bu/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ shrī sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la tri yaṃ sogs kyi rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang sogs brjod cing nang mchod phul/ hūm̐/ brjod med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag pa las// sna tshogs gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i skur bzhengs pa// char sprin nag po g.yo ba'i gzi brjid kyis// srid gsum zil gyis gnon la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ha ha'i gad mo yis// dgra bgegs bsngangs shing sa gsum g.yo bar byed// spyan gsum rab bgrad khro gnyer g.yo ba yis// dam nyams rengs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ber chen dgu gsol dbu la thod skam gsol// mgo rlon lnga bcu sbrul nag chun pos brgyan// sag ti'i l+h+wam dang gser ska'i sked bcings can// dbu skra smar smin 'bar ba khyod la bstod// phyag g.yas tsan+dan beng chen rab 'phyar bas// lha dang bdud kyi dpung rnams g.yo zhing sdud// g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu thugs kar 'dzin// dpa' bo stag la chibs pa khyod la bstod// seng ge rgyan ldan rol du khrid nas ni// lcags spyang bya khra sngon po lding zhing 'dur// sprul pa'i pho nya mang po phyogs bcur 'gyed// dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum ma// sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa rnam pa gsum// nor bdag gnod sbyin bdud nag mon pa bdun// bdud mgon spyi rings srog bdag 'od lha dkar// lcags gzhu nag po shu bo srog len dang*// klu mgon rdo rje legs pa ma mo'i mgon// rā

gza' hu rak+ṣa srin po/ btsan bdud mon mo'i tshogs// g.yas g.yon ru 'dren ma mo'i tshogs la bstod// legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma sogs nas// bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs// zhes pas bstod do// bzlas pa ni rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas pho nya dang mtshon cha'i tshogs su gyur/ dgra bgegs bkug nas bsgral/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi ye shes dang*/ go cha srung ba la sogs pa yig 'bru'i rnam par bdag la bsdus/ lha sngags nus pa gzi brjid chen por gyur par bsam zhing*/ yi dam gyi sngags dang*/ mgon po'i sngags ci mang bzla'o// de nas mchod bstod gong ltar byas la yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brten bzhugs bya/ med na mi dgos/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs bya'o// 'di ni rang gi dran gsor thar rtser sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bla ma dang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam skong ba'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ rten bshams nas 'di'i dam rdzas gtor ma'i bar paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chog ltar dang*/ skong gtor gru gsum che ba/ de'i mdun du gru gsum chung ba gsum/ de rnams kyi mthar mtheb kyu ji ltar rigs pas bskor ba/ smug rtsi sogs kyis byugs pa gtor gdugs sam ba dan sogs dang mar gyi phyag mtshan me ri sogs ci mdzes dang*/ kha zas bzang dgu ci 'byor gyis bskor/ kha rlangs sogs ma phog pa gal che/ gtor rtsam yang nas rjen btags kyi phye la/

bdud rtsi ril bu phye ma dang sman sna gang 'dzoms btab/ phud ma nyams pa dang gtsang sbra gal che/ bsad sha ma yin pa kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha rnyed na dmar rgyan bya/ bsad sha dang*/ rang gi nor phyugs shi ba'i sha khrag mi 'bul/ god kha 'grim nyen yod gsungs/ spro na/ dbang lnga'i me tog lcags kyu lnga sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa dang*/ de ma grub na chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sogs dang*/ rin po che dang*/ stag gzig pags pa sogs dang*/ rgyan drug ja bu ram ka ra go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs ci tsam 'byor pa bkod pa legs shing yid 'khul nus pa bsham/ rnal 'byor pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang dang mgon po 'di'i rjes gnang sogs thob cing dam tshig gtsang la yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen song sogs mtshan nyid ldan pas/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin bya/ 'on kyang gur zhal sogs kyi skong gso dang 'brel tshe mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi gong du 'di'i gtor bsngo byed/ phyogs skyong las gshin sogs byed pa yin na/ de dag gi yang gong du byed dgos so// gong ltar bzlas pa bshags sogs grub nas sam/ gur zhal sogs kyi skong gso byed na de dag gi rjes sam/ skabs su gang bab dang bstun no// skong rdzas byin rlabs las 'jam po'i phyogs la gur gyi skong ba he ru ka dpal ma'i mgo na yod pa'i sngags drug phyag drug sogs bya/ yang na 'di bzhin bya ste/ skong rdzas rnams la dmigs nas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po'i rtsigs pa dang rgyu ma'i drwa phyed 'phyang ba/ bse smug po'i sgo can/ steng du zhing chen gyi bla bre dang mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar/

phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs bkug nas bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag gzhan yang hūm̐ mthing nag re re las byung ba'i bya nag rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag mi nag rnams dbang po rdzogs shing rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gzig go khrab gos dar la sogs pa phyi nang gi dam rdzas dngos su 'byor pa dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa dpal rdo rje nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥbadz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ rnga sil sogs rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ hūm̐/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po ni// rab khros ma hā kā la che// mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas rnams// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// snyigs ma lnga bdor sgrub dus su// gsungs pa'i dam tshig 'dir dgongs la// mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas gsol// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas gsol// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// li yul lcang rwar u rgyan gyi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas rnams// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sngar bzhugs pa rnams la bstim/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir// dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams// dam rdzas mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis// thugs dam bskang phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol// ro bcud brgya ldan gser skyems gtsang ma dang*// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i mchod yon 'di// dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas rnams la// byon skyems dam par 'bul gyi dges par rol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/

sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de nas rol mo bzhag ste/ gtor chog ltar gtor sngags lan gsum la sogs pas skong gtor phul/ skong ba dngos ni/ dbyangs rol dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ hūm̐/ bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyi nang gi// mchod gtor mthun pa'i dam rdzas legs 'bul gyi// thugs dam dgongs la brtse zhing rab dges pas// zag med bde ba bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol// mtshan ldan thod pa dkar po yangs pa'i nang*// dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha rus don snying lnga// 'bru sna sgron me lcags kyu ye shes lnga// byin brlabs bzhed dgu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /khrag gi mchod yon dbang lnga'i me tog dang*// tshil chen bdug spos zhun chen sgron me sbar// khrag zhag mkhris chab dmar nag bshos bu dang*// rkang gling thod rnga la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// snyan brjid 'gying ba'i dbyangs kyi nga ro sogs// stag zhon 'khor bcas dges par bzhes su gsol// me dpung rdo rje gur khang yangs pa'i nang*// 'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus// mi mgo'i rtsigs pa lcang lo'i kha bad can// rgyu ma'i drwa phyed zhing lpags bla re bres// mi ro'i rgyal mtshan glo snying 'phan tshar 'phyang*// keng rus thog phub bse yi sgo glegs la// gnam lcags gzer btab khro chu'i ra bas bskor// me rlung 'khrugs pa drag po'i gnas khang 'di// legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag dang*// mi nag mchu sder rab 'jigs bya yi tshogs// dre'u dmar nag bong bu gwa dmar dang*// seng ge glang chen gcan gzan 'jigs pa'i tshogs// yid bzhin nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing*// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun// bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'dod yon rnam pa lnga// rin chen tshogs dang dar gos ja sogs dang*// dri bzang sman sna 'bru sna dpag med dang*// go cha mtshon cha gcan gzan pags pa'i tshogs// rin chen rus pa mi mgo sbrul rgyan sogs// thun mong mchod rdzas nam mkha'i khams gang ba// legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// khyad par rten rdzas bing dang lcags par sogs// gsang rdzas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dam rdzas sogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin dpag med rnams// gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol// de ltar rmad byung dam rdzas phyi nang gis// legs ldan stag zhon lcam dral thugs dam bskang*// sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po'i=

/las kyi mgon po bdun gyi= /sde brgyad mgon po gtso 'khor= /gnod sbyin brgyad dang gshin rje brgyad la sogs// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskangs zhing nyams chags sos gyur cig /bshags pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dgongs// bdag cag las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// spyi dang khyad par dam tshig nyams pa sogs// bsam sbyor nongs pa gang mchis mthol lo bshags// ma dag tha mal 'dzin pas bsgribs gyur te// rim gnyis ma bsgrubs bsnyen sgrub g.yel sogs dang*// mchod gtor chag dang mi gtsang phud nyams sogs// gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// dmigs med thugs rje'i klong du bzod par gsol// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las bcol ba ni/ khyed la phrin las gnyer du bcol ba ni// rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos dam bzhag ltar// rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par ring lugs 'di// srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams rgyas par mdzod// 'jig rten khams kun bde zhing lo phyug legs// chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag khyed la ltos bcas rnams// lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs stong grogs mdzod// nad gdon rims dang dgra bgegs gnod pa sogs// mi mthun bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba rnams// myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dang*// dpal 'byor 'khor dang longs spyod dbang phyug sogs// legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag dbyar mtsho ltar// gang zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// gnas 'di'i zas nor longs spyod 'khor sogs la// dgra rkun 'jab bus khyer la ltas ngan thong*// zhi bas mi 'dul gdug can dbyings su sgrol// nyes pa kun bral legs pa'i gzhi things la// bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa 'dzin par mdzod// mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnams// gang bcol thogs pa med par 'grub pa dang*// sa lam bgrod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las rgya cher mdzod// bzlog pa ni/

hūm̐/ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu ma chung*// sogs brjod/ bstod pa la rnga brdung bar spro na/ gong gtor bsngo'i skabs su mi byed par 'dir bya'o// bstod pa'i tshig ni/ hūm̐/ brjod med spros bral sogs gtor chog ltar ro// thun gtor ram/ mgyogs gtor 'bul bar spro na/ gong bsham gyi skabs su/ lcags sder la sogs par gtor chung gru gsum dmar po bzhi bshams la/ skabs 'dir/ legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma sogs kyis khang steng la sogs pa gtsang sar 'bul/ dmigs pa ni mgon po'i sprul pa pho nya las mkhan rnams kyis gtor ma bzhes shing dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bsams la rol mo'am dril gsil bcas sngags shub bur bzla'o// thun gtor ma byung yang skyon cher med/ de ltar gtor gzhi gcig la yun ring du mchod gtor 'bul na snga ma rnams la gtor ma dngos gzhi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas phud nas cung zad 'bul zhing yongs rdzogs 'bul ba'i dmigs pa mi byed/ nub re bzhin mtheb kyu kha gsos pa rnams 'bul ba yin la/ mtheb kyu yang lnga tshar sogs kyi gral gyi dam rdzas gtor ma dang*/ skong gtor gnyis char la mtheb kyu bzhi re gso ba byung na legs/ dmigs bsal ni gtor ma dngos gzhi la che chung bzhi re yod pa/ mgon po lcam dral/ nang gi las mkhan/ phyi'i 'khor tshogs spyi rnams la re re yin par snang bas so// mtheb kyu rnams kyang ma rul ma 'bag sa la ma lhung ba sogs dgos so// gtor gzhi spod pa'am mchod gtor grol ba'i tshe gtor ma rnams yongs rdzogs 'bul ba'i dmigs pa byed/ spro na/ yi dam gyi gtor ma ma gtogs khang steng sogs su spyi bstab kyis dbul lo// mtshan mo yin na grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar dgos par bshad/ nyin mo mi dgos so// rjes kyi bya ba rnams gtor chog ltar bya'o// de ltar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam skong ba'i cho ga lag len rab gsal phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni don du gnyer bas bskul ba'i ngor/

'di'i yi ge rnying pa mang du mthong yang*/ tshig gi cha bde ba dang byin rlabs che khyad sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i skong gso la gtso bor brten zhing*/ gzhan nas kyang legs bshad kyi cha cung zad blangs nas shākya'i dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// 'dis mtshon dge tshogs ma lus bsdoms pa'i mthus// ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob bar// lus rten bla ma chos sogs mthun rkyen kun// bka' srung rnams kyis 'bad med 'grub par shog /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chog gi lhan thabs yin no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /stag zhon gyi rjes gnang gi cho ga bzhugs so// swa sti/ dpal ldan nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po sbyor ba la stegs kyi steng du tshom bu mchod gtor sogs dkyus ltar bsham/ slob dpon gyis yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed nas bzlas pa'i bar grub nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang thob pa'i slob ma bdun sogs khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu tshar nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen byang chub sgrub pa'i ched du dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan rgyu'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang*// zhes gsungs pa'i don snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos byed kyi gang zag shin tu dkon zhing*/

re re tsam byung ba yang phyi nang gi bar chad shin tu mang bas/ de'i 'gal rkyen sel bar byed pa la srung ma re bsten dgos/ de la yang 'jig rten pa'i srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ pho lha dang mo lha dang zhang lha la sogs pa bsten kyang*/ tshe 'dir bar chad phra mo tsam sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen phran tshegs tsam sgrub nus kyang*/ mthar thug byang chub sgrub pa la gegs byed pa yin pas snying rje'i bsam pas gtor ma re ster ba tsam ma gtogs/ bsten cing srung skyob byed pa'i lha ma yin te/ sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba yin lags/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dam pa'i chos gsungs pa'i tshe rang rang gi srog snying phul nas bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa ste/ de dag bstan pas don 'grub par bshad kyang*/ gnyis pa de las khyad par du 'phags pa rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i srung ma re bstan dgos pa yin/ de la yang rgyud sde bzhi nas gsungs pa'i srung ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla med kyi phyogs yin/ de la yang rnam grangs du ma zhig gsungs pa las 'dir gtso bor gyur pa pha rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa yin/ de la yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba la chos skyong gcig dgos par dgongs nas gdul bya drag pos 'dul bar mkhyen te/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po shin tu khros pa'i tshul mdzad/ de'i thugs ka nas ye shes mgon po 'di shin tu 'jigs pa'i skur sprul zhing*/ mthu stobs che la gnyan pas ye shes mgon po legs ldan stag zhon zhes grags so// 'di la yang lugs srol du ma zhig byung ba las 'dir slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas nas bla ma rong pa rgwa lo la bka' babs pa'i dpal mgon nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/

gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa bsnyen pa song ba zhig dgos par bshad/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ bla med la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa la sogs pa zhig dgos par bshad/ nam bya ba'i dus ni mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can la bya dgos par bshad/ gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong ba phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa zhig dgos par bshad la/ tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub nas/ gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi dang po la slob dpon la yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung ba dngos yin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dang por me tog phog pa yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhabs la 'dud// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs nas/ blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab nas/ rgyun bshags bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung ba la/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa la chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs par mos nas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas 'grub par shog ces rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yis// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag la// che btsan mgon po nag po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang ni// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i phyir// dam pas bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba rnams yod pa las thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung ba dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang gi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ khyad par du rnam smin gyis bsdus pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched/ nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bya sgro mes bsregs pa bzhin gzhob thul gyis bsregs te/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs par mos/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po nas phaiṃ gyi sgra sgrog pa'i sku can du gsal btab nas slob dpon la yi dam gyi lha dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo khro mo rnams dang*/ lcang lo can dang ma la ya'i gnas la sogs pa nas dpal ldan mgon po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te/

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gang bas gdon bgegs log 'dren gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ slar 'dus te khyed rang rnams la thim par mos/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che ba ri rab tsam la sogs pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sogs brjod cing rol mo dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug de ltar na dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rnams kyi lus kyi sdig sgrib dang 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs nas/ khyed rang rnams dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag gcig gsal btab/ slob dpon la yi dam gyi lha dngos yin snyam pa'i yid kyi gus 'dud mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis byung ste/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ shrī ma hā sogs brjod do// de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/

gsum pas brtan par mos nas/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul gyis me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab nas khyed rnams kyis me tog phul ba de slob dpon gyis khyed rang gi mgor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// khyed rnams kyi rgyud la dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig de ltar na dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi rjes gnang sogs gong gi sku'i rigs 'gre bya'o// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la yi dam gyi lha dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas lcang lo can dang*/ ma la ya sogs na bzhugs pa dang mdun gyi dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo tsan+dan gyi beng dang*/ lcags kyi par pu la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bas gdon bgegs log 'dren la sogs pa tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus te khyed rang rnams dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i snying gar thim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang gu gul gyis bdug cing rol mo bya'o// de ltar na dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob sogs 'dra/

des sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba grub nas/ mtha' rten yon tan phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo khro mo chos skyong srung ma'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs pa gsal bar dmigs la/ de'i steng cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bar thams cad tho brtsegs su bzhugs par mos te/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu bka' bsgos par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shrī ma hā sogs kyi mthar/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ phung byed shān+tiṃ gar+bha/ raṃ bu gu h+ya tsaṇ+ḍa/ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ bal po bha sun+dha ra/ grub chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston grwa pa kun dga' grags/ se'i ban+dhe 'bum phrag gsum pa/ skyo'i ban+de mthu chen/ lce btsun mdo sde seng ge/ rong pa rgwa lo/ lce blo ldan seng ge/ bla ma sle'u chung ba/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ dbon chen chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ pha rgod rin chen rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje

bhāṭ+ṭā ra kā ā kā sha bud+dha/ btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ chos rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ grub dbang sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ byams pa bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ stag gzhon dang 'bral ba med par gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dkon mchog grags pa la'o// yang na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas/ lce btsun mdo sde seng ge bar sangs phun pa'i gsan yig ltar dang*/ de nas rong pa rgwa lo rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig 'di rnams kyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i= gzhan yang gzugs can dgra'i gnod pa dang*/ gzugs med bgegs kyi gnod pa dang*/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong dang mnan gtad gzer gsum la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad= mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa/ nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i= lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus nas zas gos longs spyod kyis phongs pa med pa yid bzhin du 'byor pa dang*/ de dag gis kyang bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa'i= rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi chos tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i 'byung po gdug pa can dang*/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang dmod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ bla ma'i sku la sdo ba/ bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa thams cad zhi ba'i tshul gyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon/ dpal ldan lha mo/ sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa/ las kyi mon pa zor thogs bdun/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje/ byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin/

sha za mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mi thul ba med pas mngon spyod kyi tshar bcad nas 'di rnams kyi bran bzhin du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du srung bskyab sba ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces bka' bsgos pas gtor ma'i steng gi dpal nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas 'gal rkyen thams cad sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub par mdzad pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ lus longs spyod la sogs pa drin lan du 'bul na/ cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum/ deng nas sogs brjod do// de nas rjes kyi bya ba gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni brang btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang gis dran gsor sug bris su byas pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /swa sti/ stag zhon 'khor kha bskang rgyu/ dgra bgegs kyi dpung 'joms par byed pa zhes pa'i rjes su/ rgyab tu nor bdag dzaṃ bha la nag po g.yas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon ne'u le brla steng du 'dzin pa/ dar dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing rna ba ma phug pa rigs ngan gyi cha lugs can/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyis nor bdag ser po gan rkyal du mnan pa/ de rnams kyi rgyab na bdud kyi mon pa gri thogs bdun rngam zhing bdud dmag 'bum khri'i dpung gis bskor bas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa/ mon mo nag mo bdun la 'khor bud med stong khams khengs pa/ bh+yoḥdang dzaḥyi sgra sgrogs shing khrag thun gyi zor 'phen zhing dgra la dal yams gtong ba/

de'i lcags mkhar sogs nas rdul du rlog pa/ btsan mgon shu po srog len mdog dmar nag dar dmar gyis thod bcings pa ber dmar bse khrab gyon pa/ mdung dmar khrag gi ba dan can dang*/ btsan gyi zhags pa dmar po thogs pa/ rta dmar la zhon pa sogs/ 'di rnams paṇa chen gyi yig cha bris rnying la snang zhing*/ tri yaṃ ma'i gzhung rnying pa rnams dang khyad par tshar chen gyi yig char gsal bas spar ma la chad lus byung bar nges so// zhes pa'ang wā gin+d+ras spel ba'o// zhes so// 'di'i 'khor gyi lha chad pa rnams rje ngag dbang legs grub kyi zur tho 'di ltar dkyus su kha 'gengs zhus pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
